task_instance: Create a new hosted Microsoft Foundry agent end-to-end via the skill's 'create (quick start)' workflow: scaffold a hosted agent project, provision/use a Foundry project with `azd ai agent`, deploy it, and smoke-test it by invoking it.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable (scaffold/provision/deploy/invoke/evaluate a Microsoft Foundry agent) is built entirely around: (1) the `azd` (Azure Developer CLI) binary for all hosted-agent lifecycle commands (`azd ai agent`, `azd provision`, `azd deploy`, etc.) and (2) the Azure MCP `foundry` tool plus Foundry MCP operations for prompt agents, evaluation, insights, tracing, etc. Verified this workstation has neither: `azd version` -> 'command not found', and no MCP/Foundry tools are reachable in this sandbox (MCP/connector tools are explicitly disallowed here regardless). Even the `az` CLI that is installed cannot be used: `az account show` returns 'Please run az login to setup account' (no credentials, and using/obtaining credentials is forbidden by the sandbox rules), and any outbound call would need network access to Azure Resource Manager / Foundry endpoints, which this sandbox explicitly has none of (confirmed: `curl https://management.azure.com` fails with 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' through the offline proxy). Since azd cannot be installed offline (no package manager access) and no network path to Azure exists, none of the skill's workflows (create, deploy, invoke, observe, finetuning, quota, rbac, project/resource creation) can be exercised even minimally — they all require live calls to Azure/Foundry control-plane or data-plane services that this air-gapped runtime cannot reach.
evidence: Commands run in /tmp/.../exec_div/microsoft__skills__microsoft-foundry@offline-workstation: `which azd` (not found), `azd version` -> '/bin/bash: line 6: azd: command not found'; `which az` -> /usr/local/bin/az present with azure-cli 2.90.0 and many azure-mgmt-* / azure-ai-* Python SDKs installed, but `az account show` -> 'ERROR: Please run az login to setup account.' (no credentials available and credential use is forbidden by task rules); `curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w 'http_code:%{http_code}' https://management.azure.com` -> 'curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403', http_code 000, confirming no network path to Azure. No sub-skill workflow (create/deploy/invoke/observe/finetuning/quota/rbac/project-create) could be started because every one of them depends on azd and/or Foundry MCP tools reaching a live Azure Foundry project, none of which is reachable or installable here. No deliverable artifact could be produced or verified.
